captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a standard 9g micro servo motor. It features a main rectangular body with mounting flanges extending from its sides, each containing a mounting slot. The top of the servo includes a dual-cylindrical gear housing and a small output spline axle, while the bottom side has a rectangular cap and four small corner screw holes. A simulated three-wire cable exits from one of the narrow sides near the bottom.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric 9g servo motor model in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the main body dimensions (length, width, height), bottom cap height, flange length, flange thickness, and vertical flange position, while maintaining realistic proportions for the output spline, auxiliary gear cylinder, and wire outlet.
captions.factory: The script defines a module '9g_servo' using a union of several primitives: cubes for the main body halves, bottom cap, and mounting flanges; cylinders for the main gear housing, auxiliary gear housing, output axle, and three-wire cable; and a small cube for the wire entry block. A difference operation is then applied to subtract mounting slots from the flanges, screw holes from the bottom cap corners, and recessed circular indents on the bottom.
